pr_body:
Fixes #17870 by restoring support for old parameters to `/api/v1/admin/accounts`.

Also creates `/api/v2/admin/accounts` with the new parameters.

issue_context.title: 500 on admin API when filtering by `pending`
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce the problem

HTTP GET to `/api/v1/admin/accounts?pending=True` with correct `admin:read:accounts` token.

### Expected behaviour

Should return a filtered list of pending approval accounts. As documented here: https://docs.joinmastodon.org/methods/admin/

### Actual behaviour

Returns no content and a 500 error

### Specifications

If you don't provide this query param it returns the normal un-filtered response.

This used to work fine on an older version (I think 3.3). Since upgrading to v3.4 this long running script has broken.

No combination of `pending`, `pending=True`, `pending=true`, `pending=1` works.
